rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for ginger, covering both the rhizome used as a spice and the ginger plant when the context makes the distinction clear.

example.english: I add a few slices of ginger when I make chicken soup, and it feels nice and warming.
example.traditional: 我煲雞湯嗰陣會落幾片薑，飲落去暖笠笠。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou1 gai1 tong1 go2 zan6 wui5 lok6 gei2 pin3 goeng1 jam2 lok6 heoi3 nyun5 lap6 lap6
